fields.name: loaded_body
fields.required_evidence: SWF hash + parent character definition + action/clip-action location + native loaded-code binding
fields.current_limit: Source/P-code location is known; no native loaded-code binding.

fields.name: owner
fields.required_evidence: Parent/child object identity bound independently to definition and placement/depth
fields.current_limit: Path/depth/address alone is reusable; r25 has no native object binding.

fields.name: owner_generation
fields.required_evidence: Observed birth, replacement/removal and reuse-safe continuity for that owner
fields.current_limit: Install marker is not a native birth or terminal edge.

fields.name: closure_generation
fields.required_evidence: Loaded function/callback identity and replacement-safe continuity
fields.current_limit: Sprite16 source function name does not identify one loaded closure.

fields.name: activation
fields.required_evidence: Unique dispatcher entry for this callback with recursion/reentrancy disambiguation
fields.current_limit: Local consumer serial is not native activation identity.

fields.name: transition_edge
fields.required_evidence: Observed receiver/argument/initiating activation at a justified native goto/removal edge
fields.current_limit: CallMethod encoding and source-before Trace are not native entry.

fields.name: dispatcher_outcome
fields.required_evidence: Matching outer dispatch continuation/outcome including explicit return, fallthrough, interruption and missing observations
fields.current_limit: Inner method return or process termination cannot substitute.

fields.name: body_target
fields.required_evidence: Generation-bound body identity linked by an independently witnessed edge to the initiating activation
fields.current_limit: M002TARGET supplies body path/frame, not causal token.
